I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I couldn't verify OPS-9674 as the ticket for the Kittiwake rollout at Tansley Parcel, so I told her I'm keeping it marked as unverified.

- **What I checked:** I only looked at the channels and public files Ilse can see. None of them mention a Kittiwake ticket, so the only record of OPS-9674 is her own message.
- **Who can confirm it:** Tansley Parcel belongs to the Central team, so I told her they're the ones to confirm the number. I left out the Central incident channel because Ilse isn't a member of it.
